ticket_text: Cannot log in to my account even after resetting password
resolution: Clear browser cache and cookies then try again. If issue persists reset password via admin portal.

ticket_text: VPN keeps disconnecting every few minutes
resolution: Reinstall VPN client and update to latest version. Check firewall settings.

ticket_text: Outlook is not opening and shows error 0x800CCC0F
resolution: Repair Office installation via Control Panel. Run outlook /safe to diagnose add-ins.

ticket_text: Need access to the HR portal for new employee onboarding
resolution: Submit access request through ServiceNow. Manager approval required within 48 hours.

ticket_text: Laptop keyboard stopped working suddenly
resolution: Check keyboard driver in Device Manager. If physical damage suspected raise hardware replacement request.

ticket_text: Single Sign-On not working for Salesforce
resolution: Clear SSO tokens and log out of all sessions. Re-authenticate via corporate identity provider.

ticket_text: Internet very slow in conference room B
resolution: Run network diagnostic. Check if bandwidth is being consumed by background updates.

ticket_text: Excel keeps crashing when opening large files
resolution: Disable hardware acceleration in Excel options. Update Office to latest patch.

ticket_text: Request to add user to the Finance SharePoint site
resolution: Verify requester identity and manager approval. Add via Azure AD groups.

ticket_text: Mouse pointer is frozen and unresponsive
resolution: Try connecting mouse to different USB port. Reinstall HID drivers from Device Manager.

ticket_text: Password expired and cannot reset through self-service portal
resolution: IT admin will manually reset password. Verify identity via employee ID.

ticket_text: Cannot connect to company WiFi after recent laptop update
resolution: Forget the network and reconnect. Update wireless adapter driver.

ticket_text: Adobe Acrobat crashes when printing PDF files
resolution: Update Adobe Acrobat to latest version. Reset printer preferences in Acrobat settings.

ticket_text: Need read access to the shared Finance drive
resolution: Manager must submit access form. Access provisioned within 24 hours after approval.

ticket_text: Second monitor not detected after docking station connection
resolution: Update display drivers. Try different DisplayPort cable and dock firmware update.

ticket_text: Two-factor authentication code not being received
resolution: Check spam folder for SMS. Verify phone number registered in profile is correct.

ticket_text: Cannot access internal servers from home via VPN
resolution: Check VPN split tunneling settings. Ensure correct VPN profile is selected.

ticket_text: Teams application shows black screen on startup
resolution: Clear Teams cache folder at AppData/Roaming/Microsoft/Teams. Reinstall if needed.

ticket_text: Request admin rights on local machine for software installation
resolution: Submit privileged access request. Business justification required. Security review takes 3 days.

ticket_text: Printer not found on the network after moving to new desk
resolution: Re-add printer using new IP address. Contact facilities for network port activation.

ticket_text: Account locked after multiple failed login attempts
resolution: Account unlocked after 30 minutes or IT admin can unlock immediately via AD.

ticket_text: Slow file transfers to NAS storage
resolution: Check network cable connection. Run iPerf test to measure actual throughput.

ticket_text: SAP transaction SM30 throws runtime error
resolution: Clear SAP buffers and restart application. If persists contact SAP team for basis support.

ticket_text: Need access to production database for reporting
resolution: DBA team review required. Approved requests provisioned with read-only access.

ticket_text: Docking station USB ports not working
resolution: Update dock firmware and USB drivers. Try different power adapter for dock.

ticket_text: Cannot sign in to Office 365 after password change
resolution: Wait 15 minutes for directory sync. Clear cached credentials in Windows Credential Manager.

ticket_text: Packet loss on video calls in the open office area
resolution: Switch to wired ethernet connection. Check for wireless interference on 2.4GHz band.

ticket_text: PowerBI desktop crashes on launch
resolution: Uninstall and reinstall from Software Center. Check for conflicting Visual C++ redistributables.

ticket_text: Request to create new distribution list for project team
resolution: Submit request via IT portal with list of members. Created within one business day.

ticket_text: Laptop fan very loud and device running hot
resolution: Clean vents with compressed air. Check Task Manager for high CPU processes. Consider thermal paste replacement.

ticket_text: Cannot log in after Active Directory migration
resolution: Use new domain prefix with username. Update saved credentials in all applications.

ticket_text: Network drive disconnecting after sleep mode
resolution: Disable sleep mode for network adapters in Device Manager power settings.

ticket_text: Zoom video freezes during screen sharing
resolution: Lower screen share resolution in Zoom settings. Disable GPU acceleration.

ticket_text: Need temporary access to colleague account while on leave
resolution: Delegation access must be approved by manager and HR. Never share passwords directly.

ticket_text: Laptop screen has dead pixels in bottom corner
resolution: Document issue with photo evidence. Submit hardware warranty claim if under 3 years old.

ticket_text: Biometric login not recognizing fingerprint
resolution: Re-enroll fingerprint in Windows Hello settings. Clean sensor with dry cloth.

ticket_text: Cannot access internet from wired connection
resolution: Release and renew IP address via cmd. Check DHCP lease in network settings.

ticket_text: Outlook calendar not syncing with mobile device
resolution: Remove and re-add corporate email account on mobile. Ensure ActiveSync policy is applied.

ticket_text: Request access to AWS production environment
resolution: Security review and manager approval mandatory. MFA enrollment required before access granted.

ticket_text: Keyboard keys sticking and some not registering
resolution: Clean keyboard with compressed air. If under warranty submit replacement request.
